mapper.select: SELECT * FROM course_assignments WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM course_assignments WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND dedupe_key = #{dedupeKey}

SELECT * FROM course_assignments WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY (completed_at IS NOT NULL) ASC, COALESCE(due_date, DATE(due_at)) IS NULL ASC, COALESCE(due_date, DATE(due_at)) ASC, assignment_id ASC

SELECT a.* FROM course_assignments a LEFT JOIN courses c ON c.course_id = a.course_id AND c.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.confirm_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND a.completed_at IS NULL AND (a.course_id IS NULL OR c.status = 'ACTIVE') ORDER BY COALESCE(a.due_date, DATE(a.due_at)) IS NULL ASC, COALESCE(a.due_date, DATE(a.due_at)) ASC, a.assignment_id ASC
SELECT * FROM course_assignments WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY assignment_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE course_assignments SET source_quote = COALESCE(#{sourceQuote}, source_quote), due_quote = CASE WHEN due_edited = 1 THEN due_quote ELSE COALESCE(#{dueQuote}, due_quote) END, due_estimate_json = CASE WHEN due_edited = 1 THEN due_estimate_json ELSE #{dueEstimateJson} END, topic_id = COALESCE(topic_id, #{topicId}), course_id = COALESCE(course_id, #{courseId}) WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND confirm_status = 'CANDIDATE'

UPDATE course_assignments SET confirm_status = #{confirmStatus}, duplicate_of_assignment_id = #{duplicateOfAssignmentId}, version = version + 1 WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE course_assignments SET due_kind = #{dueKind}, due_date = #{dueDate}, due_at = #{dueAt}, due_source = #{dueSource}, due_edited = 1, version = version + 1 WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND version = #{version}
